line.en: tuesday is cool and calm, about 15 to 18 degrees, with cloud building later. sunset is at 17:13, so walk the nea paralia from the white tower before the light goes.
line.de: dienstag ist kühl und windstill, etwa 15 bis 18 grad, später zieht wolke auf. der sonnenuntergang ist um 17:13, also die nea paralia vom weißen turm aus gehen, bevor das licht weg ist.
line.tr: salı serin ve durgun, yaklaşık 15 ile 18 derece, akşama doğru bulut artıyor. gün batımı 17:13'te, o yüzden ışık gitmeden beyaz kule'den nea paralia boyunca yürü.

sparks.why: Tuesday 17 nov forecast (light wind, cloud building in the evening) and sunrise 07:11 and sunset 17:13 from a weather page updated 12 nov (sunheron.com); the promenade is a standing public place, not a dated event.
